title: Universal Quantum Gate Compilation in $SU(2)_k$ Anyon Models via Multiple-Braiding
summary: We investigate the capability of multiple-braiding in $SU(2)_k$ anyon models to realize universal quantum computation. The multiple elementary braiding matrices (MEBMs) are derived from the $q$-deformed representation theory of $SU(2)$. Through a general analysis of the MEBMs, we find that multiple-braiding loses its universality only when the braiding multiplicity $m$ causes the MEBMs to collapse to a scalar (up to a global phase).
